target_customer: Developers and engineering teams that need integrations, scrapers or RPA for websites that have no API
problem: Browser automations break when sites change and are costly to maintain; teams need reliable, code-owned automations.
business_model: usage-based developer platform with tiered subscriptions

founders.name: Faisal Ilaiwi
prior_employers: UiPath (3.5 years, Engineering Manager then Director of Engineering)
education: College in Palestine (school not named on the YC page)
founders.background_notes: Source: YC page. YC lists him as the only founder.

technical_complexity.rationale: Running reliable headless browsers with stealth, proxies and auth at scale was real engineering for a one-person founding team, though browser frameworks like Playwright already existed.

defensibility.rationale: Customers keep automation code in the platform, but browser infrastructure and scraping tooling were broadly copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent acquisition or copy found in searches through 2026. AI browser agent frameworks later became the main substitute.

market_need_then: Founder says he left UiPath frustrated with brittle RPA; his own blog post describes frustration at a job in summer 2022 before applying to YC. No dated spend data found.

identity.logo: Lowercase wordmark; a design studio (Carberry and Hanrahan) is credited on Dribbble for a later branding project

branding.brand_signature: Code-first positioning ('Built in, not bolted on')

brand_strength.rationale: Brand sources show a professionally designed identity but no community, merch or press about the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Intuned is active as of 2026 with a small team and an AI agent that builds and repairs browser automations. No public funding beyond the standard YC deal was found, so its trajectory is unknown. The product moved from a code-first automation platform to an agent-assisted one as AI browser agents emerged, and no exit, layoff or shutdown has been reported.
notes: Funding unverified: CB Insights says $500K over 2 rounds (convertible note, 2022-09-07), EveryDev lists seed $500K 2022-07, VCBacked says pre-seed 2022-08; all aggregators, round type and date conflict, so not recorded as a round. RuntimeWire says total funding is undisclosed. Competitors: no source dated at or before the 2022 batch was found; Launch HN thread found was undated in the results. Apify and Browserless are named only in undated 2026 comparison pages. Completeness pass: the 500K convertible note dated 2022-09-07 is recorded from CB Insights alone; EveryDev says seed 2022-07 and VCBacked says pre-seed 2022-08, so stage and date conflict. Rests on a single database; RuntimeWire says terms are undisclosed. A search summary mentioned a second co-founder, but the YC page lists only Faisal Ilaiwi as Founder, so none was added.
